description: Use when you need airport delays, FAA ground stops or the airport status of a US airport right now, such as departure delays or closures. Do not use for the status of a flight number, airports outside the US or historical delays. Returns JSON with current US airport delays from the FAA: ground stops, ground delay programs with average and maximum delay, arrival and departure delays and closures, for all airports or one for 0.007 USDC per call. Typical response time 1500 ms (p95). Category: Data. Price: US$0.007 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

airport.description: US airport code to filter, e.g. SFO or KSFO (all airports with delays when omitted)

name: blackwood_airport_delays
title: Airport delays
